established_contexts: Frozen median-opening turn with turn-path-marking control; physical indication authority pending original source review

variable_parameters.name: indication_form
variable_parameters.range_or_domain: marker, button or other indication physically placed within the sourced intersection

variable_parameters.name: turn_course
variable_parameters.range_or_domain: indicated or divergent commanded course; realized path measured independently

variable_parameters.name: course_blend
variable_parameters.range_or_domain: source-constrained numeric interpolation from indicated 0 to divergent 1; setpoint only

variable_parameters.name: realized_course_deviation_m
variable_parameters.range_or_domain: nonnegative original body-centroid distance to sourced indicated course while inside intersection; no legal cutoff
